name: Pontus
overview: Pontus was a province in Asia Minor noted in Scripture as a region where early Christians were scattered, as Peter addresses believers living there in 1 Peter 1:1. It is also identified as the birthplace of Aquila, a Jewish Christian who, along with his wife Priscilla, played a significant role in the early church (Acts 18:2). Additionally, Pontus is mentioned among the diverse regions represented at Pentecost, highlighting its inclusion in the early spread of the gospel (Acts 2:9).
